exercises.title: Part 1 · 1
exercises.prompt: Songs and singing Did you enjoy singing when you were younger? [Why?/Why not?]

exercises.title: Part 1 · 2
exercises.prompt: Songs and singing How often do you sing now? [Why?]

exercises.title: Part 1 · 3
exercises.prompt: Songs and singing Do you have a favourite song you like listening to? [Why?/Why not?]

exercises.title: Part 1 · 4
exercises.prompt: Songs and singing How important is singing in your culture? [Why?]

exercises.title: Part 2 · 1
exercises.prompt: Describe a film/movie actor from your country who is very popular. You should say: who this actor is what kinds of films/movies he/she acts in what you know about this actor's life and explain why this actor is so popular.

exercises.title: Part 3 · 1
exercises.prompt: Watching films/movies What are the most popular types of films in your country?

exercises.title: Part 3 · 2
exercises.prompt: Watching films/movies What is the difference between watching a film in the cinema and watching a film at home?

exercises.title: Part 3 · 3
exercises.prompt: Watching films/movies Do you think cinemas will close in the future?

exercises.title: Part 3 · 4
exercises.prompt: Theatre How important is the theatre in your country's history?

exercises.title: Part 3 · 5
exercises.prompt: Theatre How strong a tradition is it today in your country to go to the theatre?

exercises.title: Part 3 · 6
exercises.prompt: Theatre Do you think the theatre should be run as a business or as a public service?
